the_308_explained.question: was the 308 a leftover comments include or a routine redirect?
the_308_explained.answer: a routine same-host trailing-slash redirect from the Animedia site runtime
proof: the same 308 appears on http://127.0.0.1:9121 with a Host header, where nginx is not involved at all
the vhost contains no comments include and the snippet file is absent
the chain ends 404 and no hop carries the gateway's X-Comments-Module-Version header
POST answers 501 (the site runtime implements GET/HEAD only), not a gateway refusal

why_the_first_apply_failed.root_cause: the visitor check probed http://127.0.0.1:9121, the Animedia site runtime. The comments API is an nginx location; a request that bypasses nginx can never reach it. The probe saw the site's own trailing-slash 308 and compared it against a literal 503.
why_the_first_apply_failed.second_defect: the build-id check compared X-Site-Factory-Build-Id, which the runtime reads from template-manifest-animedia-01.json — a file the release symlink does not touch. It could not change, so 'build unchanged' proved nothing about which artifact was running.
why_the_first_apply_failed.third_defect: verification failed after four mutations and left all four in place; the owner had to roll back by hand.

reasoning: fs.file-max is effectively unbounded and only ~29k handles are allocated, so this is not system-wide FD exhaustion
RLIMIT_NOFILE is 1048576 soft and hard, so it is not a per-shell or per-user file limit
'Failed to allocate directory watch' is systemd's message when it cannot create an inotify instance for a unit directory
root's own consumption is not measurable without root; the visible count covers only this user's processes
leftover headless-chromium processes from the browser suite each hold one instance and contribute

foreign_nginx_warnings.cause: include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/* has no extension filter, so .bak copies load as duplicate server blocks
foreign_nginx_warnings.affected: yummyani.biz / yummyani.org / yummyani.site backups in sites-enabled
foreign_nginx_warnings.action: none — out of scope for this branch
foreign_nginx_warnings.harness_consequence: the deploy harness now writes its own backups to /srv/site-factory/var/comments/backups, outside every nginx include glob, so it cannot reproduce this pattern
